entities.summary: Laetitia Marie Madeleine Susanne Valentine de Belzunce d'Arenberg, mostly known as Laetitia d'Arenberg, is a French-Uruguayan businesswoman, socialite and philanthropist. Head of the Grupo d'Arenberg, she runs Lapataia, a Uruguayan brand of dairy products, chocolate, and dulce de leche.
